results.title: Playbook Image Saver
results.content:
#### Save inspiration fast

Creative process begins by gathering inspiration. Use those images to deliver a compelling story and spark imagination for your clients.

#### The only downloader that comes with a ton of storage space

Playbook offers free storage to all artists and designers, knowing that they need ample space to store their creativity.

#### Automate your creative workflow

Playbook saves images and automatically save their sources. You can also write notes on how they inspire you.

#### It takes seconds to download and try.

 Download for Chrome

 #### What browsers are supported?

  Currently, Playbook Image Saver supports all Chromium-based browsers via Chrome Store. More platforms will be available in the future!
 #### How does Playbook Image Saver work? [...] Celebrating 1M Artists and Designers!   Get inspired →

Playbook

Schedule a demo Get started for free

# Install our browser add-on

Save images, write notes or save URL directly into Playbook.  
  Download for Chrome

### Download images from any website in bulk

Powerful image saver that enables you to auto-download all images from any website or take custom area screenshots and save them directly to Playbook.

#### Install and start for free

No need to download to your computer. Save images directly to Playbook.

#### Capture and save screenshots

Take a screenshot of a page or custom area to store in Playbook

#### Auto save URL and note

..so that you'll always know where you got those inspirations.

#### Save inspiration fast [...] Playbook Extension crawls any website and gives you all available images to save to Playbook. Simply select the ones you want to save, then choose a board where you want to save the images.
 #### How safe is my data?

  Your data is safe in Playbook. Playbook doesn't claim any ownership, sell your data, or share any of it with anyone else without your consent. We're here to support creators.
 #### Can I try it for free?

  Yes! You can download the extension for free. You can also sign up for a free account on Playbook.
